title: Understanding Large Language Models as Numerical Optimizers
abstract: arXiv:2610.37932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as potential tools for numerical optimization. Despite promising results, their intrinsic optimization capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood, particularly in high dimensions. This paper investigates the ability of LLMs to exploit mathematical problem structures and generate feasible, near-optimal solutions. We develop an evaluation framework that distinguishes solution quality from execution failures, including numerical inaccuracies, constraint violations, and output-format errors. Using representative problems from convex optimization, fractional programming, and constrained projection, we assess LLM performance against deterministic reference solvers across different dimensions. Our results reveal that LLMs can capture useful optimization structures and produce near-optimal solutions, even when their outputs fail to satisfy numerical or formatting requirements. translated_title: 理解大语言模型作为数值优化器
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已成为数值优化领域的潜在工具。尽管取得了令人鼓舞的结果，但其内在的优化能力和局限性仍然知之甚少，尤其是在高维情况下。本文研究了LLMs利用数学问题结构并生成可行、接近最优解的能力。我们开发了一个评估框架，将解的质量与执行失败（包括数值不准确、约束违反和输出格式错误）区分开来。使用来自凸优化、分式规划和约束投影的代表性问题，我们在不同维度上将LLM性能与确定性参考求解器进行比较评估。我们的结果表明，即使LLM的输出未能满足数值或格式要求，它们仍能捕捉有用的优化结构并产生接近最优的解。然而，其可靠性……
tldr: 本文提出一个区分解质量与执行失败的评估框架，发现大语言模型能够捕捉数学优化问题的结构，即使输出存在数值或格式错误，仍能生成接近最优的数值优化解。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an evaluation framework that distinguishes solution quality from execution failures, revealing that LLMs can capture useful optimization structures and produce near-optimal numerical optimization solutions even when their outputs fail numerical or formatting requirements.
